method.content: For every visible main [data-family-content] block, count whitespace-delimited rendered text words and divide primary-family words by primary plus supporting words.
method.visual: For every visible main [data-family-visual] block, compute getBoundingClientRect().width * height and divide primary-family area by primary plus supporting area.
method.visibility: display is not none, visibility is not hidden, and the element has positive rendered width and height.
